label: 8.2f Digital Wallets
openQuestions: AP-02/GP-01: orderId 1-24 chars vs Test Tag length; choose a different tagField
Wallet test cards and decline triggers not documented
Worldnet wallet equivalents (applePaySessions, DIGITAL_WALLET payload; Elavon only) not authored here; see WN-28 for HPP

scenarios.title: Apple Pay: start merchant session
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies the Apple Pay session-start call returns a startSessionResponse.
steps: Verify domain in Self-Care and obtain appleDomainId.
On onvalidatemerchant, POST /v1/payments/apple-pay/sessions with processingTerminalId, appleDomainId and the validationURL verbatim.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200 with startSessionResponse; payment sheet proceeds.
scenarios.pitfalls: Terminal-path variant /v1/processing-terminals/{id}/apple-pay-sessions also exists. Success status code not stated.

scenarios.title: Apple Pay: payment approved
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies the hex-encoded Apple Pay token is accepted.
steps: Authorise in the sheet on an Apple device.
Hex-encode the token and POST /v1/payments with paymentMethod digitalWallet, serviceProvider apple, encryptedData.
Call completePayment according to the result.
scenarios.testData: Apple Pay sandbox card in Wallet on an Apple device (setup per Apple)
scenarios.pitfalls: order.orderId must be 1-24 chars, so the 30-char Test Tag does not fit; embed the Test Tag in an alternative field (open question).

scenarios.title: Apple Pay: decline or cancelled sheet
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies decline and user-cancel are handled without a successful payment.
steps: Run a payment with a declining test card; cancel the sheet in a second run.
scenarios.expected: Decline in transactionResult body; sheet dismissed with failure status; cancel creates no payment.

scenarios.title: Apple Pay: button hidden when unavailable
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies the button is gated on canMakePayments.
steps: Load the checkout in a non-Apple browser.
scenarios.expected: Apple Pay button is not visible.

scenarios.title: Google Pay: payment approved
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a Google Pay token routed through Payroc gateway config is accepted.
steps: Configure tokenizationSpecification with the gateway constant and gatewayMerchantId from the Payroc Google Pay guide (terminal ID minus last 3 characters).
Hex-encode the token and POST /v1/payments with digitalWallet, serviceProvider google.
scenarios.testData: Google Pay TEST environment; test card via Google's test card suite
scenarios.pitfalls: Only the encrypted token is hex-encoded. Success keyed on responseCode A.

scenarios.title: Google Pay: button gated on isReadyToPay
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies the button renders only when ready.
steps: Check the page in an unsupported environment.

scenarios.title: Google Pay: declined payment
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a decline is surfaced.
steps: Complete a Google Pay payment with a declining trigger.
